market.question: Will the highest temperature in Wuhan be 28°C on May 5?

assessment.reasoning: Wuhan early May avg highs ~26°C, with May 5 expected near 26°C. The 28°C bucket is just above the central forecast; conventional 1°C-bucket distribution gives moderate probability to hitting one degree above the modal estimate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Daily synoptic variability and forecast uncertainty band.
